llm_response.reason: The website exhibits several scam website hallmarks: (1) It claims to specialize in a well-known brand (Merrell) but provides no legitimate company details, legal info, or real business contact information (violating characteristic #4 & #6); (2) almost all navigation is limited to generic shop pages (wishlist, cart), not normally expected for a legitimate online retailer; (3) there is use of urgency tactics and non-specific promotions; (4) there is a placeholder non-description in the site footer ('Write a short description about your site here'), indicating a template or unfinished scam site; (5) use of a single-brand focus, which is commonly spoofed by fake shops; (6) the copyright date is for 2025 with no legal or company name, suiting characteristic #7. All these are consistent with a scam fake online shopping site designed to harvest payments or data without actually delivering authentic branded products.
